protocol_scope: BRJD local independent matched-capacity additional experiment
legacy_hash_rule: runtime SHA recorded into calibration, local baseline freeze, pre-pilot plan and all manifests; parent freezes the common kvbench adaptation separately
gpu_policy: one BRJD GPU exclusive to R260401; all arms run on same GPU serially; no other timed GPU experiment

calibration.single_flow: A0 complete eight-stage, reset between repeats
calibration.baseline: median of all three BRJD local observed latencies

capacity.common_blocks: minimum feasible natural integer block count, frozen before pilot
capacity.all_timed_arms: exact same actual allocator token count

timing.absolute_deadlines: multiply frozen local baseline once before pilot

load_axes.open: Poisson rate .95*C_tokens / local calibrated expected-token-seconds *[.7,1,1.3]; independent holding factors1/3/6; all arrivals pre-generated before arm timing
load_axes.sampling_plan: freeze tau/tokens, capacity-derived N and rates, actual deadlines, actual holding targets and repetition rule before pilot endpoints

formal_selection: max paired SD from open-loop P-admit minus A-uncap; smallest10..20 Bonferroni paired-t forecast simultaneous half-width<=.05; otherwise20 and underpowered
primary_family: three open-loop rates x three deadlines, P-admit-A-uncap; nine members
inference: interval_estimation_only, approximate normal independent repeat differences
denominator: every generated cohort session in [30,150); blocked and unfinished at drain count as misses; execution errors invalidate cell and stop
token_trace: unchanged prompt/output SHA per stage; common admitted cohort SID paired audit; drift or partial evidence cannot support identical realized workload claim
pipeline_fixes: remove undefined pre-pilot audit_path/drift reads; audit metadata belongs to post-experiment summary
restore startup-time evidence from persisted server JSON on resume
validate local baseline/hardware/model/calibration source hashes before pilot/main
